notes: Punctuated speech: the recognizer adds full stops, so every sentence starts with a
capital. A capital there is no evidence of a name.
'Great' and 'Cold' start sentences and are not roster words, so they are not names.
Before the fix they fuzzy-matched Grant and Col and were pre-checked.
'Colin' also starts a sentence, but the nickname table knows it -> 'Col'.
'Cold' follows the guest clause and must not become a guest name either.
'Tony' is one letter from 'Toby'. A short near-miss is a suggestion, never a pre-check.
